products.title: Time Machine from Back to the Future
products.description:
Description

Build one of cinema’s most iconic cars with the LEGO® Speed Champions Time Machine from Back to the Future. Recreate the classic first-film version with its lightning rod, then rebuild it in flying mode with sideways wheels and Mr. Fusion. Packed with instantly recognisable details including the flux capacitor and time circuits, the set also includes Marty McFly and Doc Brown minifigures for the full time-travelling experience.

357 pieces · Ages 9+
